The '''Rhannon Hills''' are an extensive hill range located east of [[Ebou Dar]]. They run almost from the city for a hundred miles until they meet the [[Venir Mountains]]. The [[farm]] belonging to the [[Kin]] is located a few miles from the city to the northeast, close to the hills, and [[Rand al'Thor]] fought the [[Seanchan]] to a standstill north of the hills.
